title: Jayden Daniels: Brandon Aiyuk's my brother, but I have no sense of his football future

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jayden Daniels: Brandon Aiyuk's my brother, but I have no sense of his football future
sources.description: The Commanders have been seen as a landing spot for wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk since it became clear he would not be playing for the 49ers anymore, but Aiyuk remains on the roster for San Francisco.
